name: Zsarolyán (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Zsarolyán: a white and blue shield with a figure, with a helm, an arm-and-sabre crest and blue and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed ZSAROLYÁN.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Zsarolyán arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
